title: Subthalamic and thalamic local field potentials during DBS in cervical dystonia, DC-removed derivative at 4096 Hz
description: Local field potentials recorded from externalised octopolar DBS leads in 7 patients with isolated cervical dystonia (12 hemispheres), spanning the subthalamic nucleus, rostral zona incerta and ventrolateral thalamus. Recordings were made 4-7 days after surgery, off medication, during stimulation ramps and single-pulse protocols, with scalp EEG, neck EMG and accelerometry in some patients. This derivative release at 4096 Hz, repackaged to BrainVision format, has DC offset removed by the original authors.
methods_description: Recordings used a TMSi Saga amplifier at 4096 Hz with Boston Scientific Vercise Standard leads. Tasks were continuous 130 Hz monopolar DBS with stepwise intensity increases, single-pulse stimulation at each contact level, and one paired-pulse recording. Spike2/MATLAB exports were converted to BrainVision float32 with values unchanged.
